title: 2026 Black Canyon Ultras 100K — official results
claims: The 2026 Black Canyon 100K results page lists 765 finishers.
The men's top five were Hans Troyer 7:20:00, Anthony Costales 7:24:32, Tracen Knopp 7:26:45, Canyon Woodward 7:37:27 and Jordan Bramblett 7:42:32.
The women's top five were Jennifer Lichter 7:57:05, Anne Flower 7:57:59, Tara Dower 8:11:46, Molly Seidel 8:25:13 and Abby Hall 8:27:50.
The results page puts Lichter 54 seconds ahead of Flower; a RUN247 race report gives Flower 7:58:15 and a 70-second gap.
